revision_rule.note: IEEE 1800-2012 places the Observed-region clocking-block event rule under input sampling rather than clocking block events.

The 2012 clocking_event grammar permits @ identifier or @(event_expression), whereas the 2023 grammar directly permits @ ps_identifier and @ hierarchical_identifier; the declaration grammar therefore differs materially.
Although one 2012 sentence says positive integer, the same clause explicitly defines legal ##0 behavior, so the effective permitted domain is non-negative integers.
Although the general expression sentence says positive integer, the same subclause explicitly defines ##0 behavior, so the permitted values and behavior match.
Although the 2012 declaration sentence says positive integer, the same chapter explicitly defines legal #0 skew behavior; the effective skew domain includes zero.
The general sentence says positive integer, while the same chapter explicitly defines legal #0 clocking skews; together the permitted non-negative domain matches.
